native_install_mechanism: Cursor project rule plus SessionStart hook at .cursor/hooks.json
supported_runtime_versions: Cursor with Project Rules and hook support
install: Commit .cursor/rules/super-build-kit.mdc, .cursor/hooks.json, and hooks/. The project SessionStart hook invokes the WCBS transport.
update: Update the project rule, .cursor/hooks.json, Kernel, and hook files; Cursor re-reads them next session.
uninstall: Remove the Cursor rule, .cursor/hooks.json, and WCBS-owned hook files. Nothing outside the project is modified.
rollback: Restore the previous rule and hook files from version control.
limitations: The project hook path is structurally tested, but a clean Cursor runtime session is Not Run. If the hook is unavailable, activation degrades to the always-on rule and is recorded as T2.
deprecation: Designed adapter; runtime activation evidence is pending.
